apps.name: InkNote
apps.subtitle: Tactile iPadOS Note-Taking & Lecture Studio
apps.localizedDescription: Handwriting & PDF annotation studio for iPad with scribble-to-erase, circle-to-lasso, draw-and-hold shape snapping, multi-tab workspace, infinite canvas, and hybrid on-device lecture transcription.

versions.localizedDescription: Initial release with PencilKit ink, scribble-to-erase, circle-to-lasso, draw-and-hold shapes, multi-tabs, PDF import/export, and hybrid Apple Speech + WhisperKit transcription.

privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: InkNote uses the microphone to record audio synced with your handwritten notes.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: InkNote uses on-device speech recognition to transcribe lectures and dictate notes live.
